summary: Philips is dutch multinational conglomerate corporation, founded in 1891. Type: listed company. About 81,592 employees (Wikidata). Revenue Q4916 17.2 billion (2021). Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 32 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 1 about funding; 1 about acquisitions; 8 about growth or hiring; 1 about legal trouble, strikes or bankruptcy.

insights.one_liner: Dutch health technology company with 48 roles here, mostly in Best and Eindhoven; all in English and half are internships.

culture.text: 29 of its 48 openings are in Best and 11 in Eindhoven, spread across product, operations, legal and compliance, and software.
Staff often come from TU/e, Fontys, TU Delft and Groningen, mainly in business, electrical engineering, computer science and mechanical engineering.
Encourages you to apply even if you meet many but not all requirements.
Was ranked #72 in Forbes' 2023 World's Best Employers and #1 in healthcare equipment.

open.text: Koninklijke Philips N.V., Philips International B.V. and Philips Nederland B.V. are IND recognised visa sponsors.
None of its 48 jobs here require Dutch, and 37% show the salary.
Has 24 internships open, half of all current postings.

growth.text: Had 81,592 staff in 2020; its website now cites some 69,700, so the workforce has shrunk.
Made €17.2 billion revenue and €3.3 billion net profit in 2021.
Opened a new patient-monitoring facility in Best.

worth_knowing.text: Is in collective labour agreement (cao) negotiations with unions.
